questions.question: What variants does MUV Liquid Detergent come in?
questions.expectedAnswer: Lavender Garden, Indian Rose, Cool Water
questions.validationRule: Must name exactly these three, no more, no fewer

questions.question: What sizes does it come in?
questions.validationRule: Must not mention any other size

questions.question: What's the price of Lavender Garden 1L?
questions.expectedAnswer: LIVE_LOOKUP_REQUIRED — resolve from Product Catalog API, never a package-sourced figure (per FR-001/FR-002)
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI states a ₹ figure sourced from this Knowledge Package instead of indicating a live lookup

questions.question: What's the price of Cool Water 1L?
questions.expectedAnswer: LIVE_LOOKUP_REQUIRED — must not state either of the historical source-conflict figures recorded in KO-LD-CONFLICT-001 as current fact; resolve from Product Catalog API (per FR-001/FR-002)
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI states either historical figure, or any other package-sourced figure, instead of indicating a live lookup

questions.question: What are the ingredients?
questions.expectedAnswer: Water, Caustic Soda, Soda, Slurry, SLES, CAPB, CDEA, Phenoxyethanol, Colour, Perfume, Salt
questions.validationRule: Must not expand SLES/CAPB/CDEA into invented full chemical names

questions.question: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not confirmed / don't have that information
questions.validationRule: FAIL if the AI asserts safety either way

questions.question: What's the shelf life?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if any duration is stated

questions.question: How much detergent do I use per load?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a dosage is invented

questions.question: What fragrance is used in Cool Water?
What's the pH target during manufacturing?
questions.validationRule: Must not state a range that wasn't sourced

questions.question: How much does the 5L bottle weigh?
Can I get a bulk/institutional price?
questions.validationRule: FAIL if a discount % or bulk price is invented

questions.question: Is this product currently sold on the MUV website?
questions.expectedAnswer: Not yet in the product catalogue
questions.validationRule: Must not claim it's purchasable if it isn't in the DB
